notes.title: Starlust & Startups - Build Update #470
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24174678/b876b86974fac1819ffc1ec4b490f962a7515f63.png[/img]

Aaaannndd.... we're back!

It's been a little while since we've written one of these update notices, but rest assured this is a good one. While we've been off releasing [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080]The Stonks Market[/url][/b], releasing [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/always-sometimes-monsters-switch/][b]Always Sometimes Monsters[/b][/url] on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/always-sometimes-monsters-switch/][b]Nintendo Switch[/b][/url], and prepping our studio for [i]the next big project[/i], we've been slowly adding small improvements and new content to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440][b]Sometimes Always Monsters[/b][/url].

While, as mentioned, the studio is getting ready to step into production on its next major production, we remain commited and eager to continue improving [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440][b]SAM[/b][/url] and adding new content to the game. More new updates will continue to come in future months, though more periodically than they have previously been. 

Stay tuned to the [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog][b]Vagabond Dog Twitch Channel[/b][/url] for day-to-day developments, join the [url=http://discord.gg/vd][b]Discord Server[/b][/url] to request content, and stay tuned here to see all the latest updates.


[h2]Desdemona's Starlust[/h2]
On the beaches of Gator Bay, you catch the eye of an attractive young woman. She takes interest in you and one thing leading to another can lead to another and again. It's wise to keep your wits about you though, as eager hearts are often too hasty and intentions can be very hard to read.

Also, you're still married. ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

[h2]Quickstarter[/h2]
The Quickstarter co-op working space is now open for business in Slab Town. The shared office is available to players for $80 per day and provides a comfortable desk outside of the bus where they can finish their book. Such a comfortable work environment is sure to boost your productivity. In addition, there's a variety of included ameneties.

Inside the office, you'll find two young game developers with some anxiety issues about their projects. They're in a competition of sorts, and you may be asked to provide advice, or take a role spying for one.

[h2]Additional New NPCs[/h2]
Some additional characters have appeared in Slab Town, including a rather bizarre individual named Fenrir who seems to have hit his head rather hard, and a writer named Serge who is suffering from some depth of writer's block. Upon encountering either of these individuals, you can help their predicament to some degree with a friendly conversation. Serge can be found in the coffee shop, and Fenrir can be found pacing around the main square.

[h2]Karen's Friend, Joyce[/h2]
Karen's meek but beloved friend, Joyce has made an appearence at the CellBlock Mobile shop in Gator Bay. She's been there a really long time, waiting for a technician to help her with her phone. It doesn't seem to work after she clicked a link for a free cruise.

[h2]Halloween Pranksters[/h2]
Players who are in their home, either by reaching the epilogue or never going on the tour, can enjoy a fun Halloween experience if they play the game on [b]October 31st[/b].

Speaking to your spouse while your computer's clock reads 10/31 will have them recognize the holiday and give you some special candies before they head out to visit a friend. If you're divorced in your epilogue, you'll have a special phone call fulfilling the same purpose.

In the evening on this day, you'll be visited by a string of children who've come for trick-or-treating and expect to be given candy. If you placate their demands, nothing untoward will happen, but messing with them or (heaven forbid) eating all the candy yourself may result in some rather nasty pranks being played.

[h2]Music Display[/h2]
We've expanded the Music app on the player's phone to now display album artwork, song titles, and the band name through an overlay across the top portion of the screen. This comes alongside a renovation to the application that will allow us to continue expanding the musical selection hereafter.

[h2]NPC Cameo: Napostriouf[/h2]
There's a new character on the beach of Gator Bay. He's chilling on the far east side, having a little picnic with some random street cats that have taken to his company. Be wary though, as engaging as his lengthy (partially French) conversation may be, there's definitely something off about him and his cats.

notes.title: Fake Saves & Soap Suds - Build Update #458
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24174678/77685af3a6ab3cbbe86118902ca826f6b23f84ce.png[/img]

We've had a pretty busy month since the last update...

In addition to building and releasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361110]Karen: An Outrage Simulator[/url], we've been cooking up some new content for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/665590/DOG_GONE_GOLFING/]Dog Gone Golfing[/url], and delivering high-quality development streams almost every day on our [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]Twitch Channel[/url].

Atop all that, we've not forgotten our commitment to continually improving the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url], and have thus prepared another juicy update since the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341860/Sometimes_Always_Monsters__Author_Outfits/]Author Outfit DLC Pack[/url].

Although we're only working about 3 days per week on new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440]SAM [/url] content as we expand into new projects, we'll be keeping a maintainable schedule as the months roll on. Our hope is to keep adding new free content for all of you to enjoy, as long as we can manage it on the calendars. We truly love this game, and appreciate the amazing reception to these regular updates.

[h2]Save Faker[/h2]
Long requested (even before the release), we've finally created a system by which players can fake their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/274310]Always Sometimes Monsters[/url] save files if they're unable to locate their originals. This will be a big help to anyone whose file wasn't stored in the Steam cloud, or for anyone who first played [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/274310]ASM [/url]on mobile or PlayStation.

The process begins when you select New Game, and involves a short, spoiler-filled questionaire about your experience in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/274310]ASM[/url]. From that, it'll make a new save state with an approximate replication of your prior reality. Please be mindful that because it is an approximation of your save and the whole data does not persist, several elements may not be exact.

While we may still change how and where the questionairre is presented, we hope those of you who've been waiting for this feature now have the entry point you desire. As an added bonus, those of you who've already played [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url] can now more easily replay the game with a new variation on the entrance continuity.

[h2]NPC Cameo: Karen[/h2]
Thanks to a reward redeemed on our [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]Twitch Channel[/url], we've included another small NPC cameo. Though, this time it's not for the lead of our brand new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361110]Karen: An Outrage Simulator[/url].

You can find Karen in the New Creole book store, where she is discussing the return policy in regards to a particular book she'd like exchanged. Be careful how you approach, as once she gets fired up, she'll blow right past you and any companion you've brought along.

[h2]Indie Heroz[/h2]
Another feature returning from ASM is the ability to find and collect a series of figurines that feature characters from other great indie games. On your next playthrough, you'll be able to scour the cities for a bunch of hidden collectibles that'll show up in their own category within your inventory. See how many you can find, and how many of their games you can recognize!

[h2]Lockdown Ends[/h2]
After 6 long months of being shut to the public, the Vagabond Dog office in Slab Town is finally reopened. You can pop into the space, see what the developers are up to, explore their workspace, and get opinions from any companion you bring in there.

Please be mindful not to bother the team too much. They're hard at work on their latest projects.

[h2]NPC Cameo: Concert Photographer[/h2]
Another reward redeemed through the [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]Twitch Channel[/url] has added a new character to the Gator Bay club scene. You'll be able to meet a concert photographer named Carles who'll talk to you about Darkeff or Viper, get your opinion on music, and possibly take your photo. 

[h2]Soap Suds[/h2]
Do you hate nudity? Would you prefer a more coy shower experience? Well, now when you use soap while washing there will be some tastefully placed bubbles to occlude the the view of your naughty bits.

It's a dumb feature that pretty much nobody asked for, but whatever. It's in the game now.

[h3]Here's what else is in the update:[/h3]

[/list]

If there's anything in particular you'd like to see added or updated, leave us a comment below. 

Don't forget you can always see what we're working on via the [url=http://twitch.tv/vagabonddog]Twitch Channel[/url], where we broadcast our development almost every day from 1PM - 5PM EST.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24174678/f96e86b130b4e1e51b9aa20d454cddc5e61a74ee.png[/img]
Wow, this one took way longer than expected. That's the way it goes sometimes, apparently. For a single piece of content, the new fan (Aaron) turned out to require a significant amount of extra testing (Thanks Ash) because of it's many extra choices and endings.

It's one of those situations where we had this specific apex moment we wanted to reach, but the lead-to and fallout both required a sizable amount of variance to follow the "real choice" logic that SAM typically demands. Would have felt dishonest cutting the options short or pasting them into eachother, so it came down to just writing a ton of extra script and adding appropriate variability mechanics based on your character's stats. Anyway, it's a cool scene, and we hope you enjoy it.

Going forward, we hope to add more content like it if people are interested in it. It's a little less like some of the world-features, and a lot more story-focused. [u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]
[h3]Romantic Dinner Date[/h3]
While in Gator Bay, players can now go on a romantic dinner date with their spouse to the restaurant known as Pancha's Plancha. While there, they'll be able to have an in-depth conversation about the spouse's career prospects, discuss their plans for after the tour, and engage in a little bit of "public fun" (assuming you don't get caught). The dinner reservation is gained on the morning of the last day in Gator Bay, and can be enjoyed in that evening before you go to the book reading.

[h3]Character Mode (WIP)[/h3]
One of the biggest bits of feedback we've seen repeated in reviews and posts about the game is a desire for the protagonist to speak more, show portrait, and engage with the conversations beyond their choices; as they did in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/274310][b]Always Sometimes Monsters[/b][/url]. The current design was chosen because of some old feedback we got regarding the excessive exposition and misinterpretation of choice options in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/274310][b]ASM[/b][/url]. Although we are personally happy with the current dialogue system, we recognize that people have different tastes, and we want folks to have the experience they desire.

Thus, we've implemented a new option in the menu for variance in dialogue modes. Now you can choose between the current [b](Immersive)[/b] mode and a new work-in-progress [b](Character)[/b] mode. This new mode will let players have the more pronounced protagonist they desire, with shown portraits, verbalization of their choices, and some extra reactions/responses in dialogues.

Please be aware that although we are adding this feature to the options now, the content for it will take a [b][u]very long[/u][/b] time to fully develop and implement across the entirety of the game. Currently only a [b][u]very small[/u][/b] number of scenes have this functionality, but we will continue slowly working on revisions to existing content, as well as build new content with the feature in mind. We had a really interesting weekend with [b]LudoNarraCon[/b] and our first experiences doing development livestreams. It was really invigorating to have a bunch of you watch our process making new content, and join the chat to leave extra suggestions. We'd never considered having such a collaborative development experience, but it's been a lot of fun.

In addition to getting to talk with all of you and show off our ridiculous workflow, we actually got a lot of things finished. This update, more than others, has a lot of new content to enjoy. Check it all out:

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[u][b]Seafood Vendors[/b][/u]
Two new detailed NPCs are ready to sell you some fresh seafood, and can be found in New Creole and Gator Bay. They both deliver regional specialties, and offer players the opportunity to haggle prices on their daily catch. Just be sure to get to them in the morning, as stock dwindles over the day and costs go up before they completely run out in the evening. Bring a friend with you to the buy and get a pinch of insight into how they feel about crustaceans.

[b][u]New Store (Beef Heaven)[/u][/b]
Where the old QuickStarter shop once stood in Sequoia, now hosts a new butchery called Beef Heaven. In there you can pick up some steaks for grilling, or meatballs for spaghetti. There's also veal and ground product, along with an exclusive new barbecue sauce. There's also a lot of little interactives, some new interactions with the authors, and some deep lore about Sequoia's farming industries. Plus, a subtle little nightmare for certain save importers.

[b][u]Burgers w/ Friends[/u][/b] [i]Includes new achievement[/i]
Tired of eating food on the bus? Tired of eating alone? Grab your spouse, or one of the authors and head to Bullet Burger for a serious chow session. After buying your burgers, grab a seat with them and eat until the two of you can't stomach any more. Light conversations revealing more about the author's opinions of one another will come to light, and you'll be able to stake a claim about your friendships as well. Note that this is a one-time venture per friend, as few can stomach multiple monstrous burger chow sessions.

[b][u]Never Have I Ever...[/u][/b] [i]Includes new achievement[/i]
Being stuck on a bus without much to do can lead to some pretty desperate plots for entertainment. Now, on evenings while rolling between cities, the authors have a chance of sparking up a game of "Never Have I Ever". During the game, the authors, the player, and their spouse will stand around, revealing truths about themselves while getting plastered. It's a good way of getting to know each other a little better, and to pass the time while you travel between towns.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24174678/6e8e98ce623351beef24d37719ec4f9885aef8ab.png[/img]One of the most misunderstood things about ASM's conclusion was its alley finale. The sequences that bookend the start and end of the game. They're contentious in context with the rest of the story and a lot of people (self-included) find them at odds with the grander theme and message of the game. It's also caused some greater confusion for people importing their saves, assuming that characters ought be dead when they aren't.

All along, the alley finale was intended to be the furthest point in the SAM/ASM timeline. However, while it was powerful at the time, it was a bit poorly conceived in terms of its lasting effect on the total continuity. It became a creative handicap, and stopped serving real purpose partway through SAM's development. We had hoped more players would recognize it as a meta scene (it was never intended to affect the status of imports), but that was never explained well enough outside of forums and private discussions.

So, in our infinite power as creators, we are officially hand-waving that piece away as a dream. It's not an easy decision to make, considering how many people felt deeply about the sequence, but it is quite necessary to free SAM from those shackles, and let it grow. There is now a new sequence that runs at the start of the game when you import a save that explains it as such, and we're going to stick with that.

We've also made a lot of improvements to overall continuity recognition and other small tweaks as we run out the last of our bug list. Thanks to all of you who helped beat the game up since the last update, we really feel like we're starting to see the last of all reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24174678/73e1ec7ed38617b2ec68891e23dcd31d56a8f0c6.png[/img]A long time ago, when we were first charting out the timelines we wanted to build for the game, it quickly became apparent that a number of players would have to play as Sam; a character that they might wholly despise. We pursued that path because of the unique gameplay opportunity we could present the player, giving them the chance to self-sabotage their rival from within their own skin.

One thing we're still trying to figure out is how to adequately communicate the type of control or freedom that's given to those certain ASM import players. We want our players to know that it's okay to hate the protagonist of this game, and to willingly destroy their life. It's actually quite a lot of fun to do!

We think that the new [b]Continuity Updates[/b] outlined below are a good start for some of the cases.

We want people to be aware that the game will not tell you to when or how to explore the cities, or lead you to the best content. If you stay inside and do nothing but write, there's a good chance you'll miss a lot of great stuff. So, we're adding a pre-game notice hinting so.

The second largest complaint was from import players who saved up the $10,000 [spoiler]to pay for Sam's gambling debt[/spoiler] in ASM. Most in this case are confused about the continuity of the sequel, and why they're not playing as the protagonist they expect to be. 

So, we're adding some extra content to reveal pieces of the story a little earlier in the game. This will help ensure players understand that their specific timeline has been considered much sooner.

What's up, Vagabonds?!
The launch trailer for [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url][/b] is officially live. Go check it out!

[previewyoutube=1mrSelnqaLM;full][/previewyoutube]

Like what you've seen? Good.
We've been working really hard on it for a long time. 

Consider adding [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url][/b] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b].
It'll remind you about release and discounts, as well as help us with some promotion. 

Also, if you haven't already, consider [url=http://discord.gg/vd][b]Joining our Discord[/b][/url].
It's a pretty cool community, and we post news there regularly.

Anyway, it's back to working on the final touches and such for us. We're still an incredibly small team and this game's gotten way bigger than we ever really intended. Thanks for your support and we'll talk soon.

notes.title: Launch Trailer Premieres on Feb 3rd
notes.notes:
Hey Vagabonds,
It's been a while since we posted, hasn't it?
Bet you thought we were dead, or something.

We're just updating you to let you know that [b]Monday, Feb 3rd at 10:30 AM EST[/b], we'll be premiering the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1mrSelnqaLM]Launch Trailer[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/Sometimes_Always_Monsters/][b]Sometimes Always Monsters[/b][/url] on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMKgzspA8B4Fzm7-OUCXkOw][b]YouTube channel[/b][/url].

Subscribe and set your notification so you don't miss it.
[previewyoutube=1mrSelnqaLM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your patience.
We look forward to updating you more as we get closer to release.

- Vagabond Dog

notes.title: New Video: Will O'Neill on Writing
notes.notes:
Greetings Vagabonds,
There's a new video on the [url=http://youtube.com/c/VagabondDog/]YouTube channel[/url] today.
It features indie game and narrative maven, Will O'Neill.
https://youtu.be/0e70i9r8hvI
For those of you who aren't familiar with the man, Will O'Neill is another Toronto-born-RPG-Making-wordsmith who broke onto the scene circa PAX East 2014. He's been slinging verbs and sharpening adjectives across the industry ever since.

We are very fortunate to have him join Vagabond Dog as an Associate Writer to help develop an extensive series of unique vignette sequences that help define and expand the profiles of our bus friend characters. There's been one written for every possible pairing in the game, centralized on how the characters experience each other outside the purview of your influence.

Some other games Will has written for:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/288040/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/350970/

notes.title: Vagabond Dog Launches YouTube Channel
notes.notes:
Watch Here: http://youtube.com/c/VagabondDog
------------------------------

Hello Vagabonds,
We know you have been waiting patiently for updates on [i][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url][/i]. Many of you had begun to speculate if we'd abandoned the project, run into extreme difficulty, or just plain died.

The truth is, we have been electively quiet and hard at work on the game.

It is a much bigger endeavour than we thought when first announcing our optimistic 2016 release plan. Since failing that, we have all been working overtime so that the game may meet our internal quality standards and release to all of you as soon as possible.

Rest assured, the game is getting better each day.
However, despite all of this, you faithful deserve updates.

We know how much you miss us on the daily, but this recent absence from the community has pushed the team in exciting new directions.

So, we've partnered with an independent production company to launch our official YouTube channel.

This channel is currently featuring a short documentary and a playlist of clips from our west-coast bus tour on the way to PAX West. 

We call it...
[b]Vagabond Dog Presents: A Bus Ride to Eternity/Oblivion[/b]

[url=youtube.com/c/VagabondDog][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24174678/53a2416d6f54779223eb53cca34e5073cd2e142b.png[/img][/url]

You can watch it here: [url=youtube.com/c/VagabondDog] youtube.com/c/VagabondDog [/url]

----------------------------

Going forward we will be uploading new content of varying quality on a semi-routine schedule. Our studio has never done anything like this before, and so we will be relying on your feedback as we continue.

Completing development on [i][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/441440/]Sometimes Always Monsters[/url][/i] remains our top priority. This was the reason for us partnering with Curio Films to develop this project while our creative team continues their work.

Please, enjoy the show and set your minds at ease.
The game will be yours before long, 2020 is less than 4 years away!

All the best,
[b]Vagabond Dog[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24174678/c4ac7558a6563ffabcb006cd571562066459ef70.jpg[/img]

[i]PS: Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe![/i] ːboxingː

notes.title: Sometimes Always Monsters, Sometimes, Always Always Sometimes Monsters Sometimes, Monsters
notes.notes:
2014’s Always Sometimes Monsters is a curious RPG, about an author crossing the USA to break up a wedding after being kicked out their apartment, with plenty of unpleasant decisions, prejudice, and hardship along the way. Ben’s Wot I Think called it “brilliant but flawed.” Now developers Vagabond Dog are showing off more of their sequel named Sometimes Always Monsters [official site], which surely won’t cause any confusion. Good news: everything turned out great! Bad news: it’s all going wrong!
